opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

deadlines.raw: The deadline for applications is the 31st January 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24 as part of an initiative to develop young talent within the farming industry. The 2026 scholarship was open to UK applicants with a demonstrable interest in dairy or regenerative agriculture; the 2027 programme plans dairy and pig scholarships.
opportunities.summary: A fully funded scholarship for young people (aged 18-24) to develop their understanding of the industry through a 30-day study tour, staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, plus an induction day in London, attendance at the Nuffield Conference and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. Applications open in November 2026.
